body:
felix: Postmortem follow-up: recurring storage eviction pattern + inconsistent on-call checks. Need a compact runbook patch with: (1) single-page triage checklist, (2) exact first-responder commands, (3) a "recurring-patterns" appendix and a short routing play. Who takes which?

amira: I can do the triage checklist and add exact PromQL + a 4-step verification matrix. Will include which dashboards to open.

noah: I'll own the first-responder command block and a tiny how-to for attaching logs to the ticket.

felix: Assign due dates so this lands before the next patch window. Also add alerts mapping to owners.

amira: Tentative: triage PR by 2026-04-02. Will include checks: cache_hit_ratio, eviction_rate, kv_warmup latency and a smoke test.

noah: Command snippets I'll add:
```
POD=$(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl logs -n inference $POD --since=15m | egrep "evict|kv_warm|oom"
# promql examples:
sum(rate(cache_eviction_total[1m]))
avg_over_time(kv_warmup_duration_seconds[5m])
```

felix: Alert names to reference: AlertCacheEvictionHigh, AlertKVWarmSlow. Provisional thresholds: eviction_rate > 2/min for 3m, kv_warmup_duration > 10s for 5m. I'll review for noise by 2026-04-06.

amira: I'll also add a brief routing play: on eviction spike + hit_rate < 0.7 -> route to smaller-context model for 10m, run smoke test, then re-evaluate.

noah: Opening PRs and will tag INC-3247. alerts-bot: reminder set for 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC to review runbook PRs.

felix: Thanks — this thread = canonical action list.
